title: Prove the all-cap formal concave tariff for repeated A2 st
body:
For every field K, d productive A2 st targets, paid scalar-coupling cap b, arbitrary finite restored dirty spectators and free scalar GL mixing, this package proves the exact common concave formal price:

2 * (floor(d/b) * f(b) + f(d mod b)).

Paid factors are exactly I+([u]-[e])A, u in {s,t}, 0<rank(A)<=b. The common f is nonnegative, nondecreasing and discretely concave, with f(0)=0. The full group-algebra endpoint restores every spectator and off-diagonal coefficient. Singular/nonprojector couplings are allowed. Established selective regular cuts give separate rank demands d; credited packing and coordinate blocks close every remainder. For d=5,b=2,f(k)=k/(k+1), the price is 11/3.

Only research/a2-st-all-cap-tariff/ is added. This answers the identical st portion of Benny Zhao / zhaobenny #6817's nondivisible-target handoff. It does not reclaim its d3/cap2 theorem, packing method or divisible cases. Credit Adam Gall #1941 and Ross Richardson #1966/#1989 for separate-letter cuts, David Arias #2738, Nick Petalas #5083's distinct longest-element schedule, own excluded #6550 classification and retained ywz65/eumemic/Ali Romman/Gareth Davidson lineage. No new invariant is claimed. Exact source pins and byte-identical prose are retained; no predecessor scientific program ran.

Scope explicitly changes bit-new-register-model to this partial formal tariff application. Native calls, coupling-rank to recursive-child-rank conversion, physical GL cost, routing, ownership/restoration implementation, precision, stock and the complete supplier invoice remain unknown. All five selected assumptions remain; no kappa/frontier change or original-card acceptance. Other targets, alphabets and heterogeneous prices remain outside scope.

Canonical main refreshed at 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a, priority revision8, selected #6030. Explicit handoff, no picker draw. Fresh main/source6817 and all768 PR bodies/heads were unchanged; relevant all-state searches found no exact counterpart within inspected coverage. Unpublished work is unknown. Canonical claim/history: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/6814#discussioncomment-19451022 . Hub pointer: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19451065 .

- Written field-independent proof, including characteristic two. Source-aware proof/code/metadata AI roles found no blocker; not blind independent, human or proof-kernel acceptance.
- All722 2x2 matrices over F2/F3/F5 (668 nonprojectors), 2,888 one-gate cut checks,108 complete formal endpoints with378 paid calls (297 dirty-coupled),144 price cases and7 controls. One-gate exhaustion is not all-word enumeration. Nonconcave/nonmonotone controls refute packing outside its premises, not completed legal words.
- First new run0.161s/21.65625MiB. Direct normal/optimized, both registered commands and Git-free read-only empty-PATH exported replays give the identical49,624-byte packet, SHA256 32eb5c0d6a66781c0f603fbab2bbb0171b70ed00ab8f31b354d069d5474baab5.
